extracted.intended_audience: Internet Archive visitors and general public interested in psychology/MKULTRA/fringe topics
extracted.subtask_description: A single-item Internet Archive page giving title, description, topics, file/download options, and moderation/flagging categories for an uploaded video about mind control and related topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flagging / Report categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Flag this item for: Graphic Violence; Explicit Sexual Content; Hate Speech; Misinformation/Disinformation; Marketing/Phishing/Advertising; Misleading/Inaccurate/Missing Metadata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the moderation/report categories presented to users to report content on the item page. The page lists these discrete reasons but provides no further on-page guidance or thresholds for when to use each flag.
